concept_classifications.AgentDefinition: Canonical agent blueprint/template defining roles, prompt templates, model policies, tool policies
concept_classifications.AgentInstance: Active runtime execution unit tied to a conversation, session, or task
concept_classifications.Conversation: Durable multi-agent collaboration context containing plan versions, agent instances, tasks, and events
concept_classifications.Task: Actionable work node within a conversation with dependencies and canonical lifecycle state
concept_classifications.TaskGraph: DAG of tasks representing the plan execution structure
concept_classifications.WorkflowDefinition: Catalog blueprint of structured multi-step automated pipelines
concept_classifications.WorkflowRun: Execution instance of a workflow definition with distinct step runs and derived progress
